Location:	Alexandria, NSW, 2015
Full-Time:	Immediate start
Job Title:	Quality Assurance Manager
Salary Range:	$110,000 - $120,000| depending on skills level and work experience + superannuation.
Job Closes Date:	30 Days  

About the Role
On behalf of our client, an artisan bakery renowned for its wood-fired sourdough and commitment to traditional methods, we are seeking an experienced Quality Assurance Manager. This role ensures our client’s premium products consistently meet the highest quality and safety standards. 

Key Duties and Responsibilities
Quality & Compliance
• Schedule and conduct detailed audit inspections across production, storage, and dispatch, analyzing batch data and documentation to verify adherence to recipes and hygiene protocols.
• Identify variations in ingredient sourcing, fermentation times, or packaging, flagging high-risk areas to prevent quality drift.
• Recommend corrective action plans and process improvements to resolve non-compliance, such as adjusting proofing schedules or sanitation procedures.

Technical Systems & Troubleshooting
• Diagnose and resolve system issues affecting ovens, mixers, or temperature monitoring software, coordinating with production teams to minimize downtime.
• Test and identify functionality errors in inventory or scheduling systems, ensuring code and configurations perform to specification under quality protocols.
• Perform architecture reviews of hardware and software used in order management and production tracking, advising on upgrades or replacements.

Training & Documentation
• Develop and deliver technical guidance and training on operational procedures, including equipment use and quality checkpoints.
• Create and review procedural manuals, technical reports, and maintenance logs for ovens, proofers, and refrigeration units.

Requirements
• Degree in Food Science, Quality Management, or related field.
• Minimum 1 to 2 years QA experience in food manufacturing, preferably bakery.
• Strong knowledge of HACCP, GMP, and auditing principles.
• Experience troubleshooting production software and hardware systems.
• Excellent communication and training skills.
• Relevant qualification to above field.

To Apply
If you are a dedicated quality assurance professional ready to take on a key leadership role within a leading FMCG business, we encourage you to apply. 

Please submit your resume and a cover letter detailing your relevant experience through the application portal.
Please note: We are acting as recruitment agents on behalf of our client. Employer details will be provided to shortlisted candidates.

About Us

Coral Coast Distributors (Cairns) Pty Ltd is a privately owned retail and distribution business servicing regional and remote communities throughout the Kimberley region of Western Australia.

Our operations support retail stores and distribution activities that provide household goods and everyday essentials to regional communities. We are committed to delivering excellent customer service while maintaining efficient and compliant business operations.

The Role

We are seeking a motivated and organised General Clerk to provide administrative and clerical support to our Derby operations.

This full-time position is responsible for a broad range of office administration duties and provides support to management and operational teams across the business. The successful applicant will be highly organised, accurate and capable of managing multiple priorities within a busy office environment.

Perform a broad range of administrative and clerical duties.

About the Business:
Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd is a leading Australian meat processing, wholesale and export company specialising in the sourcing, processing, packaging and distribution of premium halal-certified meat products. The company supplies a wide range of fresh and frozen beef, lamb, mutton, goat and poultry products to domestic wholesalers, retailers, food service providers and international export markets. With a strong reputation for quality, reliability and strict adherence to Australian food safety and halal certification standards, Hilal Meat fosters a collaborative, values-driven workplace culture that emphasises integrity, continuous improvement, team support and a commitment to excellence in everything we do.
About the Position:
The Accountant (General) plays a vital role in supporting the financial integrity and strategic growth of Hilal Meat Products Company Pty Ltd. Reporting to senior management, this position is responsible for managing core financial operations, delivering accurate reporting and analysis, ensuring regulatory compliance, and providing insightful financial guidance to support informed business decisions in a dynamic meat processing and export environment.
Key Responsibilities:
Preparing and analysing financial statements including balance sheets, income statements and cash flow statements to provide a comprehensive view of the company’s financial performance.
Developing budgets and financial forecasts to assist with business planning and effective financial management.
Ensuring compliance with tax laws and regulations through the preparation and filing of tax returns, management of tax payments and handling of audits.
Conducting internal and external audits to verify the accuracy of financial records and maintain regulatory compliance.
Maintaining accurate financial records, including general ledger management, bank statement reconciliations and recording of financial transactions.
Analysing financial data to identify trends, assess performance and deliver insights to management for strategic decision-making.

Strong technical skills in financial reporting, budgeting, tax compliance, auditing, record-keeping and financial analysis, with proficiency in relevant accounting software.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, high attention to detail, strong communication and interpersonal skills, and the ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment.

On behalf of our client Gulf Hydraulic, we are seeking a qualified Fitter General, fitter and turners /Machinists for a full-time position in Malaga. Gulf Hydraulics Australia is a leader in the Hydraulics Industry for the service and repair of Hydraulic Pumps, Motors and Cylinders and has been recognised as service provider for the offshore, industrial and mining sectors.

Primary responsibilities Fitters and Turners
 
- Assembled and fitted precision hydraulic cylinder components, including barrels, rods, pistons, glands, and specialized seal kits, to full operational compliance.
- Operated workshop machinery and heavy press equipment to accurately install interference-fit bushes and components.
- Conducted diagnostic pressure testing, including bypass and static pressure leak testing, to verify fluid power integrity and safety standards.
- Utilized precision hand tools and torque equipment to tighten fasteners and sub-assemblies to exact OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) specifications.
- Maintained quality control records, documented test data, and assigned unique job identifiers/ID tracking to completed units prior to final surface finishing (coating/spraying).
- Setting up and operating conventional lathes and milling machines to turn, face, thread, or bore metal stock.
- Machining new or worn parts (like reclaiming a worn cylinder rod or machining a new gland/piston from scratch) to exact tolerances.
- Using engineering drawings and precision measuring tools (micrometers, vernier calipers) to machine components down to the millimeter.

Primary responsibilities Machinist
•     Operate machine tools such as lathes, milling machines,
•     Manufacture rods, glands, pistons, barrels, bases, fittings, bushes
•     Review specifications for a job.
•     Calculate where to cut or bore.
•     Shape steel, aluminum, other materials.
•     Determine how fast or slow workpiece is fed into machine.
•     Determine how much material to remove.
•     Select tools and materials for the job.
•     Plan the sequence of cutting and finishing operations.
•     Mark the workpiece to show where cuts should be made.
•     Position workpiece on the lathe or milling machine.
•     Monitor and control feed rate and speed.
•     Ensure workpiece is properly lubricated and/or cooled.
•     Regulate temperature of workpiece.
•     Detect problems by listening for specific sounds.
•     Adjust cutting speed to compensate for harmonic vibrations.
•     Monitor the accuracy of cuts.
•     Replace dull cutting tools.
•     Check accuracy of work against specifications.
•     Ability to use precision tools (eg. Micrometers internal & external)
•     Use manual machinery.

Qualifications/Knowledge/Skills/Experience
 
•     Adequate work experience or Certificate Ill in Engineering - Mechanical Trade (Fitter & Machinist)
•     Good mechanical aptitude.
•     Excellent reading comprehension
•     Physical Stamina


The salary range is from $79,500 to $85,000 per year plus super.

On behalf of a fast-growing event media production company specializing in live streaming, video, and photography for conferences and trade shows, we are seeking an experienced Conference and Event Organizer. Key Duties and Responsibilities
Client Consultation & Customisation
• Conduct in-depth client meetings to understand event objectives, then design tailored packages that incorporate video production, live streaming, and dynamic signage.
• Respond to detailed inquiries about room hire, AV equipment, catering, and on-site media services, providing transparent cost breakdowns.

Logistics & Service Coordination
• Arrange and oversee all event logistics, including registration systems, participant travel, accommodation, and social functions.
• Coordinate the setup of complex audiovisual equipment, camera crews, lighting, and live-streaming infrastructure to match production timelines.

Contractor & Budget Management
• Negotiate service costs with vendors (caterers, AV suppliers, transport) to stay within budget while maintaining production quality.
• Supervise on-site contractors, manage variations to work orders, and report progress to stakeholders.

Promotion & Registration
• Promote conferences and trade shows through targeted campaigns, leveraging client’s media assets (sizzle reels, speaker interviews).
• Manage attendee registration systems, ensuring data accuracy and seamless check-in.

Requirements
• Minimum 3+ years in conference/event coordination, ideally within a media or AV-centric environment.
• Strong negotiation skills and budget accountability; ability to balance creative demands with financial constraints.
• Proven ability to coordinate multiple contractors under tight deadlines.
• Excellent communication and client-facing presentation skills.
• Relevant qualification to above field.

How to Apply
Please submit your resume and a brief cover letter detailing your relevant experience. Applications will be reviewed as received, therefore, please apply as soon as possible before the closing date.
